title: Video downloader, mp4, m3u8
summary: Powerful video downloader that detects web videos, supporting multiple formats.
description:
Key Features:
- Auto-detect video resources: Built-in browser automatically detects video resources on web pages. Users can simply click the download button to start.
- Supports m3u8, mp4, mpd, webm, flv, mkv, 3gp, avi, ogg, mov, wmv, asf, and more formats.
- Choose download quality: Select different resolutions to save storage space or enjoy high-definition videos.
- WIFI-only download: Set downloads to occur only in WIFI environments to avoid mobile data usage.
- Pause and resume downloads: Multi-threaded downloading with pause and resume support for stable and efficient performance.
- Online playback before downloading: Watch videos online without downloading.
- Add video links to playlists: Play videos directly from playlists without downloading.

Built-in Browser & File Manager:
- Built-in browser: Offers bookmarks, history, and 12 search engines for easy resource discovery.
- Encrypted folders: Create unlimited folders and protect them with custom PINs or screen locks for privacy.

Built-in Player:
- Multiple playback modes: Supports variable playback speed and screen rotation for flexible viewing.

Privacy & Security:
- No file read permissions required: Ensures user privacy. Downloaded videos can be exported to the gallery for management.

How to Use the Video Downloader:
1. Browse video websites using the built-in browser.
2. Auto-detect videos and click the download button.
3. Play or export videos after download completes.
